name: Fieldset
description:
The Fieldset component groups related form fields together with a shared legend, helper text and error text. It is composed of several primitives that enable customization and flexibility in its usage.

Use the `usage` prop to style it as a `fieldGroup` (default), labeling a group of Radio or Checkbox inputs, or as a `formSection`, grouping the fields of a larger form. Mark it `invalid` to show the error text.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An entry abstraction that renders the legend, helper text, the grouped fields and the error text

props.name: legend
props.description: The legend/title/label of the fieldset group.

props.name: helperText
props.description: The description text for the fieldset group.

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error text for the fieldset group shown when the fieldset is invalid.
